# VerifgoodSDK v1.0.1 — Full Reference
> GMAO (maintenance management) TypeScript SDK — 53 services
> Generated: 2026-04-13

## Initialization
```typescript
import { VGSDK, Metadatas } from "verifgood-js-sdk";

const sdk = new VGSDK({
  apiBaseUrl: "https://your-api-host.com/public/index.php",
  apiKey: "your-auth0-token"
});
```

## Metadatas (query builder)
Query builder for filtering, pagination, and column selection. Pass to getAll() methods.

### Filter Actions
| Action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| equals | Exact match |
| not_equals | Not equal |
| contains | Substring match |
| start_with | Starts with value |
| end_with | Ends with value |
| between | Range (value = [start, end]) |
| is_null | Field is null |
| is_not_null | Field is not null |
| greater_than | Greater than value |
| less_than | Less than value |
| in | Value in array |
| not_in | Value not in array |

### Methods
- `setFilter(name: string, value: string | number, action?: string = "equals"): this`
- `setFiltersFromArray(filters: { attr: string; colId: string; value: any; action: string; }[]): { [key: string]: { attr: string; colId: string; value: any; action: string; }; }`
- `setLimit(offset: number, limit: number): void`
- `isLimitSet(): boolean`
  Return true if directive limit exists.
- `filterExist(name: string): boolean`
  Return true if a filter exists in filters object.
- `getCounter(counter: string): number`
  Get a counter by its name.
- `deleteFilter(name: string): void`
  Delete filter.
- `clearAllFilters(): this`
  Delete all current filters.
- `getFilterValue(name: string): any`
  Get value from filter.
- `getFilterAction(name: string): string`
  Get action from filter.
- `isStorable(): boolean`
  If this metadata has a name it can be stored.
- `get(): { directives: { name: string; offset: number; limit: number; }[]; filters: { attr: string; colId: string; value: any; action: string; }[]; columns: { [key: string]: string | null; }; }`
  Format Metadatas according to server expectation.
- `setName(name: string): this`
  Setter.
- `hasStoredFilterEqualsTo(filters: { [key: string]: { attr: string; colId: string; value: any; action: string; }; }): boolean`
  HasStoredFilterEqualsTo.
Compare given filters with this.filters.
- `getName(): string | null`
  Getter.
- `setColumns(columns: { [key: string]: string | null; }): this`
  Setter.
Columns will be used to format data output of query.
- `setCounters(counters: { [key: string]: number; }): this`
  Setter.
- `getCounters(): { [key: string]: number; }`
  Getter.
- `setFilters(filters: { [key: string]: { attr: string; colId: string; value: any; action: string; }; }): this`
  Setter.
- `getFilters(): { [key: string]: { attr: string; colId: string; value: any; action: string; }; }`
  Getter.
- `getFilter(name: string): { attr: string; colId: string; value: any; action: string; }`
  Getter.
- `setDirectives(directives: { name: string; offset: number; limit: number; }[]): this`
  Setter.

### Examples
```typescript
const m = new Metadatas();
m.setFilter("status", "active", "equals");
m.setLimit(0, 25);
const result = await sdk.equipements.getAll(m);
```

```typescript
const m = new Metadatas();
m.setFilter("created_at", ["2024-01-01", "2024-12-31"], "between");
m.setFilter("type_lieu", "Site", "equals");
const sites = await sdk.lieux.getAll(m);
```

Response format: `{ datas: T[], metadatas: { counters: { All: number } } }`

  Update Operation using V2.0 endpoint

`OperationCreateRequest` (createRequest)
| Field | Type | Optional |
|-------|------|----------|
| operation | string | yes |
| retourClient | string | yes |
| dateOperation | string | yes |
| ficheSav | any | yes |
| idUser | string | yes |
| userId | string | yes |
| tiers | any | yes |
| __uploadedFile | any | yes |
| __action | string | yes |

`OperationUpdateRequest` (updateRequest)
| Field | Type | Optional |
|-------|------|----------|
| id | string | yes |
| operation | string | yes |
| retourClient | string | yes |
| dateOperation | string | yes |
| ficheSav | any | yes |
| idUser | string | yes |
| userId | string | yes |
| tiers | any | yes |
| __uploadedFile | any | yes |
| __action | string | yes |

**Notes:**
- Operations are the audit trail / event log of a maintenance (ficheSAV). Each operation has a `flag` that determines its type, required payload, status effects, and side effects.
- Always required fields: dateOperation (timestamp), ficheSav_id (maintenance ID), idUser (user performing action).

**Enum: OperationFlags** (field: `flag`)
The `flag` field determines the operation type. Each flag may require additional payload fields, change the maintenance status, or trigger side effects (emails, document links).

| Value | Label | Description | Required Fields | Status Change | Side Effects |
|-------|-------|-------------|-----------------|---------------|--------------|
| fermeture | Closure | Close/resolve a maintenance ticket | - | → RESOLUE (or → ATTENTE_VALIDATION_SUPERVISEUR if supervisor validation required) | Sets dateFermetureSAV; May generate CLOTURE_FILE operations if files attached; May generate AFFECTES_WORKING_TIME_UPDATE |
| reouverture | Reopening | Reopen a previously closed maintenance | date | → EN_COURS | Clears dateFermetureSAV (set to null) |
| prise_en_compte | Acknowledged | Acknowledge/take ownership of a maintenance request | - | → PRISE_EN_COMPTE | - |
| en_attente | On Hold | Put maintenance on hold (waiting for parts, customer feedback, etc.) | - | → EN_ATTENTE | - |
| a-valider | Pending Validation | Closure pending supervisor approval. Auto-generated when non-supervisor closes a maintenance that requires validation. | - | → ATTENTE_VALIDATION_SUPERVISEUR | - |
| validation | Supervisor Validation | Supervisor approves/validates completed maintenance | - | → RESOLUE | - |
| manuelle | Manual Comment | Add a manual comment/note to maintenance timeline | operation (comment text) | - | EMAIL: notifies team members with emailing_commentaire_fm preference enabled |
| relance | Follow-up | Follow up / escalate a pending maintenance | - | - | Sets isRelance flag on maintenance |
| relance/iot | IoT Follow-up | Automated follow-up triggered by IoT device | - | - | Sets isRelance flag on maintenance |
| urgence | Emergency | Mark maintenance as urgent priority | - | - | - |
| differe | Deferred | Defer/postpone maintenance to a later date | - | - | - |
| affectation/interne | Internal Assignment | Assign maintenance to internal team member(s) | affectation_id, affectes (array of user IDs) | - | - |
| affectation/externe | External Assignment | Assign maintenance to external third party (vendor/contractor) | tiers_id, affectation_id | - | - |
| affectation/externe/email | External Assignment + Email | Assign to external party AND send notification email | tiers_id, affectation_id | - | EMAIL: sends assignment notification to external party |
| affectation-tiers-accept | Third Party Accepts | Third party confirms acceptance of maintenance assignment | affectation_id | - | - |
| affectation-tiers-reject | Third Party Rejects | Third party declines the maintenance assignment | affectation_id | - | - |
| affectes-working-time-update | Working Time Update | Record/update time worked by assigned technicians. Auto-generated at closure. | affectation_id, affectes (array with time allocations) | - | - |
| photo | Attach Photo | Attach a photo/image to maintenance timeline | attachedFile_id | - | - |
| img | Image from DI | Photo taken from dispatch instruction system | attachedFile_id | - | - |
| cloture-file | Closure File | Attach supporting document at closure. Auto-generated during fermeture when files provided. | attachedFile_id, operation (file name) | - | - |
| levee-reserve-file | Reserve Lift File | Attach document to lift/clear reserve status. Auto-generated when lifting reserves with files. | attachedFile_id | - | - |
| email | Email Notification | Send email notification about maintenance | - | - | EMAIL: triggers notification to configured recipients |
| email-demande-devis | Quote Request Email | Send quote request email to vendor | tiers_id | - | EMAIL: sends quote request to vendor |
| bi | Work Order (Bon d'Intervention) | Generate/attach a work order document | - | - | - |
| consommation | Consumable Usage | Record consumption of spare parts/materials during maintenance | consommableMouvement_id | - | - |
| changement_equipement | Equipment Replacement | Record equipment replacement/swap | sortieEquipement_id | - | Creates SortieEquipement record; May trigger automatic closure |
| a_prevoir | To Be Planned | Mark maintenance as pending planning/scheduling | operation (description) | - | - |
| tache | Task | Add a task/work item to maintenance | operation (task description) | - | - |
| intervention-reserve | Reserved Intervention | Mark intervention as reserved with external party | intervention_id | - | - |
| tiersinterventionponctuelle | One-Time Vendor Intervention | One-time intervention by external vendor (not under contract) | tiersintervention_id | - | - |
| retourAFaire | Rework Needed | Work requires correction before closure can proceed | retourClient (reason) | - | - |
| retourFait | Rework Completed | Correction/rework has been completed, closure can proceed | - | - | - |

---
